title: Blip 02 is out: a second cast of 13 dialogue voices
body:
Blip 02 is live at $7.99. 104 dialogue blips for text boxes: 13 new speakers, each built from a different synthesis method. A giant, a sea captain, a bard with a plucked string for a voice, a radio comm link, a hologram, an android, a tiny fae and six more.

It exists because the people who buy dialogue blips keep asking for more voices. The one rule for this pack was that none of the new voices may sound like a voice from Blip 01.

That rule is measured, not promised. The same distinctness check runs over both casts together: 26 voices, 325 pairs, and 325 of 325 are separated on brightness or length. To prove the check can fail, each Blip 01 voice was planted back in as a copy pitched 3 percent away, and it caught 13 of 13. It also refused the first render: the new familiar sat too close to Blip 01's automaton, so the familiar was retuned brighter. The result ships in the download as series_proof.json.

Every speaker has the same eight cues as Blip 01, with the same file names, so a dialogue system already wired for Blip 01 picks up these voices by changing the speaker id.

The descriptions on the page are checked against the audio too. The question cue rises and the exclamation falls in all 13 voices, the familiar really chirps twice, and the comm link stays inside a radio band. 62 checks run against the exact zip a buyer downloads, plus 945 signal checks on the files.

The honest limit: these are measurements of the signal. Nobody here has listened to the pack, so the page carries a free demo with four complete voices. Play those four back to back before you buy.

AI disclosure: the code that synthesises these sounds was written with AI assistance. The sounds are procedural synthesis in code, with no generative audio model. The cover and store images are AI generated.
